theorem MvPolynomial.abs_coeff_integral_wronskian_factor_le_right {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {U' : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} {V' : MvPolynomial τ ℤ} {W : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) ℤ} (hfact : (rename Sum.inl) U' * (rename Sum.inr) V' = W) (hU' : U' ≠ 0) {B : ℤ} (hB : ∀ (n : σ ⊕ τ →₀ ℕ), |coeff n W| ≤ B) (j : τ →₀ ℕ) :
|coeff j V'| ≤ B

theorem MvPolynomial.abs_coeff_integral_wronskian_factor_le {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {U' : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} {V' : MvPolynomial τ ℤ} {W : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) ℤ} (hfact : (rename Sum.inl) U' * (rename Sum.inr) V' = W) (hV' : V' ≠ 0) {B : ℤ} (hB : ∀ (n : σ ⊕ τ →₀ ℕ), |coeff n W| ≤ B) (i : σ →₀ ℕ) :
|coeff i U'| ≤ B

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_integral_wronskian_factors_div {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {r : ℕ} (Dx : Fin r → List σ) (Dy : Fin r → List τ) (φ : Fin r → MvPolynomial σ ℚ) (ψ : Fin r → MvPolynomial τ ℚ) (P : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) ℤ) (hP : (map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) P = ∑ k : Fin r, (rename Sum.inl) (φ k) * (rename Sum.inr) (ψ k)) (hWx : mvGenWronskian Dx φ ≠ 0) (W : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) ℤ) {c : ℤ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (hdet : (Matrix.of fun (i j : Fin r) => (pderivList (List.map Sum.inl (Dx i) ++ List.map Sum.inr (Dy j))) P).det = C c * W) :
∃ (l : ℚ) (l' : ℚ) (U' : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) (V' : MvPolynomial τ ℤ), l ≠ 0 ∧ l' ≠ 0 ∧ (map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) U' = C l * mvGenWronskian Dx φ ∧ (map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) V' = C l' * mvGenWronskian Dy ψ ∧ (rename Sum.inl) U' * (rename Sum.inr) V' = W

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_integral_wronskian_factors {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {r : ℕ} (Dx : Fin r → List σ) (Dy : Fin r → List τ) (φ : Fin r → MvPolynomial σ ℚ) (ψ : Fin r → MvPolynomial τ ℚ) (P : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) ℤ) (hP : (map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) P = ∑ k : Fin r, (rename Sum.inl) (φ k) * (rename Sum.inr) (ψ k)) (hWx : mvGenWronskian Dx φ ≠ 0) :
∃ (l : ℚ) (U' : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) (V' : MvPolynomial τ ℤ), l ≠ 0 ∧ (map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) U' = C l * mvGenWronskian Dx φ ∧ (map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) V' = C l⁻¹ * mvGenWronskian Dy ψ ∧ (rename Sum.inl) U' * (rename Sum.inr) V' = (Matrix.of fun (i j : Fin r) => (pderivList (List.map Sum.inl (Dx i) ++ List.map Sum.inr (Dy j))) P).det

theorem MvPolynomial.integral_factor_ne_zero {σ : Type u_1} {p : MvPolynomial σ ℚ} {q : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} {l : ℚ} (hl : l ≠ 0) (hp : p ≠ 0) (hq : (map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) q = C l * p) :
q ≠ 0

theorem MvPolynomial.degreeOf_integral_factor_le {σ : Type u_1} {p : MvPolynomial σ ℚ} {q : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} {l : ℚ} (hq : (map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) q = C l * p) (j : σ) {D : ℕ} (hp : degreeOf j p ≤ D) :
degreeOf j q ≤ D

theorem MvPolynomial.degreeOf_map_of_injective {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S] {f : R →+* S} (hf : Function.Injective ⇑f) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (j : σ) :
degreeOf j ((map f) p) = degreeOf j p

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_integral_separated_factorization {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} (U : MvPolynomial σ ℚ) (V : MvPolynomial τ ℚ) (hU : U ≠ 0) (W : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) ℤ) (hW : (map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) W = (rename Sum.inl) U * (rename Sum.inr) V) :
∃ (l : ℚ) (U' : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) (V' : MvPolynomial τ ℤ), l ≠ 0 ∧ (map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) U' = C l * U ∧ (map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) V' = C l⁻¹ * V ∧ (rename Sum.inl) U' * (rename Sum.inr) V' = W

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_integral_separated_factors {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} (U : MvPolynomial σ ℚ) (V : MvPolynomial τ ℚ) (hU : U ≠ 0) (W : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) ℤ) (hW : (map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) W = (rename Sum.inl) U * (rename Sum.inr) V) :
∃ (l : ℚ) (U' : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) (V' : MvPolynomial τ ℤ), l ≠ 0 ∧ (map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) U' = C l * U ∧ (map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) V' = C l⁻¹ * V

theorem MvPolynomial.den_dvd_of_mul_int {n m : ℤ} {x : ℚ} (h : ↑n * x = ↑m) :
↑x.den ∣ n

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_primitive_scaling {σ : Type u_1} (U : MvPolynomial σ ℚ) (hU : U ≠ 0) :
∃ (l : ℚ) (U' : MvPolynomial σ ℤ), l ≠ 0 ∧ (map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) U' = C l * U ∧ ∀ (n : ℤ), (∀ (i : σ →₀ ℕ), n ∣ coeff i U') → IsUnit n

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_primitive_part {σ : Type u_1} (p : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
∃ (q : MvPolynomial σ ℤ), C p.intContent * q = p ∧ ∀ (n : ℤ), (∀ (i : σ →₀ ℕ), n ∣ coeff i q) → IsUnit n

theorem MvPolynomial.intContent_ne_zero {σ : Type u_1} {p : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
p.intContent ≠ 0

theorem MvPolynomial.intContent_dvd_coeff {σ : Type u_1} (p : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) (i : σ →₀ ℕ) :

∃ (b : ℤ), b ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ (A : MvPolynomial σ ℤ), (map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) A = C ↑b * U
